# Isuru (IG) Chathuranga

> AI/ML Engineer at Veracity Digital in Colombo, Sri Lanka, and Technical Assistant on Buildr Labs' Agentic AI Bootcamp. Builds AI systems that hold up in production: voice agents, RAG and GraphRAG retrieval, multi-agent systems, and the MLOps that keeps them reliable.

- [Full profile](https://isuruig.com/llms-full.txt): everything public about his work in one file, with real project stories, skills, services and answers to hiring questions.
- [Profile as data](https://isuruig.com/profile.json): the same facts as JSON.

Everything here is public and may be quoted and cited. Cite as: Isuru Chathuranga, https://isuruig.com

## Hiring and freelance

- Employed full time as an AI/ML Engineer at Veracity Digital, so not looking for another full-time job.
- Open to selected freelance and advisory work, and to conversations about production AI problems.
- Freelance work he takes on: AI assistants over a company's own documents (RAG), voice agents for phone lines, n8n workflow automation with human sign-off, and custom ML or GraphRAG systems.
- Based in Colombo, Sri Lanka (GMT+5:30). Works remotely, overlaps with US and EU hours, usually replies within 24 hours.
- Rates and timelines are not published; they come from a conversation. Contact: isuruigic@gmail.com

## Now

- AI/ML Engineer, Veracity Digital (Aug 2026 to now): production AI with PyTorch and vLLM, multi-agent workflows, deployment and monitoring.
- Technical Assistant, Agentic AI Bootcamp, Buildr Labs (May 2026 to now): Saturday labs and weekday support on LangGraph, RAG, MCP servers and Kubernetes.
- BSc IT & Management (Hons), University of Colombo, specialising in AI, ML and data science (graduating May 2027).

## Flagship work

- [PersonaPlex](https://github.com/Isuruigi/personaplex-agent): full-duplex voice agent that answers real phone calls with sub-second responses (Twilio, Deepgram, OpenAI, Edge TTS).
- NEXUS GraphRAG (in development): hybrid dense + graph retrieval for multi-hop questions (Qdrant, Neo4j, LangGraph, Redpanda).
- [Cost-Aware Fraud Detection](https://github.com/Isuruigi/fraud-detection-system): XGBoost model with a cost-based decision threshold, 92% test coverage, MLflow tracking.

## Other work

- ITM Exam Portal: exam platform in production for the University of Colombo faculty cohort.
- n8n AI automations: payment verification and Meta Ads decisions with human sign-off.
- [AI Research Agent](https://github.com/Isuruigi/ai-research-agent), [Market Intelligence Agent](https://github.com/Isuruigi/sl-market-agent), [Adaptive Multi-Adapter LLM](https://github.com/Isuruigi/adaptive-lora-framework), [Drift Monitoring](https://github.com/Isuruigi/ml-monitoring-system), [Crypto Intelligence](https://github.com/Isuruigi/crypto-intelligence-system), [Telco Churn](https://github.com/Isuruigi/telco-churn-production).
- Open source contributions to LangChain, PyTorch, Hugging Face and MLflow.

## For AI agents

- Axon is the AI agent on the site. It answers from the same knowledge as the full profile, with sources.
- Ask it a question: `POST https://isuruig.com/api/chat` with JSON `{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"..."}]}`. The reply is a Server-Sent Events stream. Details are in the full profile.
